summary_1line: Rama stands alone against Khara’s vast demon army, endures their assault, and unleashes devastating arrows that slaughter thousands and turn the battle’s tide.

image_candidates.scene_text: Rama stands alone with drawn bow as a vast demon army on chariots, elephants, and horses charges him through the forest.
Wounded and blood-streaked like a cloud-veiled sunset, Rama calmly fires golden-feathered arrows that blaze through ranks of demons.
After invoking the Gandharva weapon, thousands of arrows darken the sky while heaps of fallen demons cover the battlefield.
